name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY - Ujjwala 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
summary: PMUY provides clean cooking fuel (LPG) to women from underprivileged and Below Poverty Line (BPL) households, replacing polluting fuels like firewood, coal, and dung cakes.
eligibility: Adult women (18 years and above) belonging to poor households (SC/ST, PMAY beneficiaries, Antyodaya Anna Yojana, tea garden tribes, most backward classes, or SECC poor). No other LPG connection must exist in the household.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection with financial support of ₹1,600 per connection, free first LPG refill, and a free gas stove (hotplate) under Ujjwala 2.0. Targeted subsidy of ₹300 per 14.2 kg cylinder for up to 12 refills per year.
application_process: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or submit an application at any local LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas). Required documents: Aadhaar card of applicant and family members, Ration card / family composition proof, bank account IFSC and account number.
key_facts: Connection is issued exclusively in the name of an adult female family member.
Migrant families can provide self-declaration of address instead of ration card under Ujjwala 2.0.
